newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Snap-On added to buy list.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Snap-On added to buy list.

text.p: -- Dean Witter said it added Snap-On Inc to its recommended list, and that it maintained a buy recommendation on the stock.
-- Snap-On produces diagnostic test and service equipment and also makes and distributes hand tools and related products.
-- The target price is $39 a share, based on the stock selling 15.7 times the $2.48 a share earnings estimate for 1997, Dean Witter said.
-- Snap-On has had seven straight quarters of 15 percent plus earnings per sahre growth, Dean Witter said.
-- "Snap-On is benefiting from the increasing need for specialized diagnostic equipment to repair the computer-controlled systems in today's vehicles...," Dean Witter said.
-- Snap-On plans to continue to make acquisitions to expand its product breadth and channels of distribution, analysts added.
-- Dean Witter said it continues to estimate earnings at $2.48 a share, up from $2.13, and higher than the $2.43 consensus.
